column1: Under bookkeeping rules an issued invoice is not canceled: it is corrected with a credit memo, and a credit memo is not canceled either: a new invoice is issued. This module applies that rule. This is a technical setting, not accounting or legal advice: ask your accountant to confirm that it fits your rules.

column1: Yes (default): the Cancel button disappears from invoices and credit memos, and any attempt to cancel one (admin, REST API, other code) is refused with a message. An invoice is then corrected with a credit memo; a credit memo is corrected by issuing a new invoice. Consequence to know: an invoice that is still open (for example an offline payment still pending) cannot be canceled either, and Magento offers a credit memo only once an invoice is paid. Documents that are already canceled are never modified. Canceling an order is not affected: it stays possible as long as no invoice exists. A payment refusal reported by the payment provider (payment review) still cancels the open invoice created for that payment.
